Halvard Cooling & Pack Co. Issues Voluntary Recall

Halvard Cooling & Pack Co. of Salinas, CA is voluntarily recalling fresh whole slicer cucumbers, 24-count cartons. Potential contamination with Salmonella, detected in routine environmental sampling of the packing line.

Affected product: Lot codes PK260908004 and PK260909002 printed on the case label, packed September 8, 2026 and September 9, 2026.
Distributed to wholesale distributors and food service operators in CA and NV. Approximately 227 cases are involved.

The recall was initiated on September 17, 2026 in cooperation with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (recall F-1953-2026, Class I). Customers who received the product should stop selling it and hold it for pickup.
